title: Tate's post-trip talk on solved energy
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Tate's post-trip talk on solved energy, about 1948 at University of Minnesota / American Southwest, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I I saw while on this trip, we will never have to worry about energy. That's already been figured out.

plain: A researcher named Scott Ramsay, speaking on the podcast of host Jesse Michels, describes the archived papers of a man named John Torrance Tate, which also mention a figure named Vannevar Bush. According to Ramsay, around 1948 Tate came back from a trip, apparently in the American Southwest, and said that what he saw meant "we will never have to worry about energy," because it had "already been figured out." Ramsay tells it because, if true, it would suggest someone had seen technology that had already solved the world's energy problem.
